rules.infinite_in_degree: X_1(21) has only finitely many points of degree 3
rules.sporadic: finitely many points of each degree <= 3 on X_1(21)
rules.isolated: finitely many points of degree 3 on X_1(21), so the point lies in no positive-dimensional family

points.reference: M. van Hoeij, Low degree places on the modular curve X1(N), arXiv:1202.4355; data file LowDegreePlaces (Aug 2013), line 44 (point found earlier by Najman, arXiv:1211.2188)
